entries.note: FDA classifies coconut as a tree nut; the shared seed only carries coconut-specific compounds (coconut milk via the suite alias table). This generic pattern covers grated coconut, coconut cream, and any other coconut form used in south-asian recipes. Nut-free claims must not be made on coconut dishes.
